An '''individual''' served as the [[Shadow Hand]] of the [[Sith King|King]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Adas]]<ref name="END" /> around [[27,700 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> As a Shadow Hand, they acted as the [[King/Legends|king]]'s second-in-command and his trusted [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. At the time of his [[Death/Legends|death]], Adas had given his [[Holocron of King Adas|holocron]] to them. The device had been handed down through the generations and was eventually given to the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]], who were then hailed as [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].<ref name="END" />
